title: atlax claim release (the body that closes a claim in Hestia)
description: Closes the open claim keyed by card + artifact (claim.schema.json): `atlax publish` releases it when the card's merge is published, the card's close releases it otherwise (implementation.md step 5). Names only, like the claim. Asked by hestia's FSE (thread 01M6AC2ESCY7VB98J69RFDSEC9). Writers: `atlax publish` (claudecode bin/atlax), the card's close (factory side). Reader: Hestia's claims API (a Hestia card, its FSE). Sample: claim-release.sample.json.

card.description: <initiative>/<card slug>; with artifact, the key of the claim released.

artifact.description: The artifact id (repo slug); with card, the key of the claim released.

reason.description: published: the card's merge reached the atlax repo; card-closed: the card closed without one.
